VARIANT [requiem] In a Requiem the blessing of the water is omitted: the priest does not make
the blessing with his right hand and the gesture bless-water is not performed. The water is
still added to the chalice and the prayer "Deus, qui humanae substantiae..." is still said in
full. The prayer is never omitted with the blessing.
invariants: INV-FORM-01, INV-GEO-01, INV-GEO-02, INV-GEO-03, INV-MISSAL-01, INV-ROLE-01,
